info.title: MuseCanvas Agent Core control plane
info.description: P4 admission/query API. AGENT_CORE_ENABLED defaults false; AGENT_CORE_ADMISSION_READY is a second explicit gate for new sessions/messages. This document does not claim a Runner, tool executor, media provider call, or UI.

tags.name: agent-core
tags.description: Owner-scoped durable control-plane intent and finite event replay

get.description: Feature-disabled namespace returns 404 before authentication, DB or rate Redis. Enabled requires an active authenticated owner; missing and cross-owner resources return the same 404. No Runner/tool/provider execution. Cursor is canonical decimal <= int64 maximum. Last-Event-ID is sessionId:cursor and must equal query cursor if both supplied (409 otherwise); cross-session/invalid IDs are 400. Ahead cursor is 409 before streaming. Frames have id/event/data. ready does not advance cursor. Heartbeat every ~5s; PG polling ~500ms, no connection held during waits; closes normally after 25s. Reconnect with last delivered ID; retention/gap/backlog emits resync.required and closes: fetch consistent snapshot, paginate all items until hasMore=false up to lastItemSequence, then reconnect at snapshot eventCursor. Max 500 durable events/~1MB per connection; slow/aborted readers cannot cancel Turns.

JSON body max 40000 bytes and 5 second read deadline. Body request ID is the sole authority; any Idempotency-Key header is rejected (400). Terminal or already cancel-requested replay is idempotent. Safe queued/waiting turns cancel locally only when all tool calls and approvals are terminal and all reservations are settled or released; unknown or retained dependencies preserve status/active turn/leases, recording cancellation and a durable wake for a future Runner. Running work likewise only records cancellation and a durable wake, preserving its lease.

Identical final decision replays fixed decision_revision; opposite decision/hash is 409. Rejection never cancels entire Turn; acceptance never blindly queues it.

get.description: Feature-disabled namespace returns 404 before authentication, DB or rate Redis. Enabled requires an active authenticated owner using the muse_session cookie; missing and cross-owner resources return the same 404. Private annotations never append Agent items or events, enter model context, or start Runner/tool/provider execution. No admission-ready gate is required. Any Idempotency-Key or Last-Event-ID header is rejected (400). Shared per-owner read rate limit: 90 requests per 60 seconds. Only limit and cursor query keys are accepted, each at most once; query string max 1024 characters. limit is a canonical positive decimal integer from 1 to 100, default 50. cursor is an independent opaque base64url value of 1 to 512 characters, bound to this resource scope; malformed, noncanonical or cross-scope cursors return 400. Artifacts are deduplicated and ordered by source item sequence descending, then artifact ID descending. Text comes from assistant messages; media requires committed owner/tool/job/output proof.

NoIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
NoIdempotencyKey.description: Rejected: request IDs in the JSON body are the sole idempotency authority.

NoLastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
NoLastEventId.description: Rejected on Artifact endpoints; event replay headers are not Artifact pagination cursors.

NotFound.description: Missing or foreign owner-scoped resource; disabled feature also uses 404

Unavailable.description: Feature/admission gate closed or safe definition unavailable

content.description: Nonblank PostgreSQL-compatible UTF-8 text. Maximum 32000 UTF-8 bytes (x-maxUtf8Bytes); a multibyte string may pass maxLength and still be rejected by runtime byte validation. No NUL or unpaired surrogate.

attachments.description: Managed inputs already staged for this owner, e.g. a prepared inpaint mask plus its source. Order is canonicalised before the idempotency digest, so the same set in any order is the same request.

ApprovalSummary.description: revision is the parent Turn revision frozen at decision time when final, or current Turn revision when pending; not an independent approval counter.

MessageAttachmentRef.description: A managed input a turn may name. Ownership, checksum, dimensions and liveness are verified server-side at admission; a mask additionally requires a live 0045 preparation identity bound to the paired reference_image checksum. The client proves shape only.

sourceChecksum.description: Required with preparationVersion for a mask; must equal the paired reference_image checksum.

ArtifactId.description: text:<source item UUID> or media:<asset UUID>. Path values accept either case and normalize to lowercase; URI-encode the complete segment once, including the colon.

ArtifactCursor.description: Opaque canonical base64url cursor. Artifact and thread pages use independent cursor kinds, bound to the session and, for threads, the artifact. Never substitute an item/event decimal cursor or a cursor from another scope.

Artifact.description: Immutable version-1 text or media artifact. Contains safe metadata only, never a storage URL or authorization to read media bytes.

available.description: False when the backing media no longer has live availability; annotation snapshots retain safe metadata.

quote.description: Exact selected text, at most 32000 UTF-8 bytes; whitespace is allowed.

oneOf.description: Text artifacts only. UTF-16 offsets: start inclusive, end exclusive, start < end <= content.length. quote must equal content.slice(start, end); neither offset may split a surrogate pair.
Image artifacts only; coordinates are normalized to [0, 1].
Image artifacts only; coordinates and dimensions are normalized. width and height must be positive, x + width <= 1 and y + height <= 1.
Video artifacts only; durationMs must be non-null and timeMs <= durationMs.

ArtifactAnchor.description: Strict anchor union checked against the immutable artifact. whole is valid for every kind; text, image and video anchors must match the artifact kind.

ArtifactMessageBody.description: Nonblank PostgreSQL-compatible UTF-8 text, at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes. No NUL or unpaired surrogate. A multibyte string may pass maxLength and still be rejected by runtime byte validation.

messages.description: Initial message followed by replies in ordinal order. At most 100 messages including the initial message (99 replies).

ArtifactThread.description: Private owner-only annotation, separate from Agent items, events and model context. resolvedAt is null while unresolved.
